name: Landsort runt from Ankarudden

campingRules: Öja-Landsort reserve: camp/fire only designated sites. Verify current rules.

protectionRules.summary: Landsort/Torö route is highly exposed and may pass bird-rich outer skerries; verify protected-area and bird/säl-protection zones before close approaches or landings.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Avoid landing on small bird-rich skerries unless clearly permitted.
